items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: When I first joined the band... Charlie Buchanan stuck his head out the door and said, 'Who's that tenor player you have,' you know. He said, 'Maybe that's what Chick needed all the time.'

ctx.x: This band is like a one big family (inaudible). And tell you, being music director -- Like I said before, you have a lot of things -- you got to come up with a lot of ideas. Why you got that job, why do you (inaudible), why you (inaudible). make you straw boss? Why

You have ideas. It's something that you are doing. When I first joined the band, the first night that I played with the band, Charlie Buchanan stuck his head out the door and said, "Who's that tenor player you have," you know. He said, "Maybe that's what Chick needed all the time. A fella that could play all around."
